mcp.read.new.output.while.the.session.is.en: Read paginated output with session_id, command_id, status, output, next_cursor and has_more. status is running (busy), idle (command ended and reusable) or closed (session no longer usable; disconnection does not confirm remote termination). exit_code appears after command completion, error only on failure, and truncated only when true. Supply the previous next_cursor and optionally command_id to reject stale reads. Drain has_more even after idle/closed. Output availability alone never proves completion.
mcp.read.new.output.while.the.session.is.zh-CN: 分页读取输出，返回 session_id、command_id、status、output、next_cursor、has_more。status 为 running（忙碌）、idle（命令结束且可复用）、closed（会话不可用，断线时远端终止未确认）。命令完成后返回 exit_code，有错误时返回 error，输出丢失时才返回 truncated=true。传入上次 next_cursor，可附带 command_id 拒绝过期读取。idle/closed 后也应读完 has_more，不能仅根据输出判断完成。

mcp.create.a.client.connection.token.and.en: Use this tool when the user asks to generate or create a remote connection token, connection invitation, or remote assistance connection for Agenterm, including “生成远程连接令牌” and “创建远程连接邀请”. Creates a private client connection token and invitation registered with the Agenterm server; a locally generated random string cannot substitute for them. timeout_seconds sets the invitation lifetime in seconds (default 300, or 5 minutes). Returns a fixed English template with Markdown code blocks in both text content and structuredContent.display_text; structuredContent also retains the credentials and platform commands. You MUST first present the complete display_text in the language used to communicate with the user. Preserve all sections and their order, and keep commands, URLs and connection tokens exactly unchanged. You MUST put each command in its own Markdown code block so it can be copied reliably. Express the invitation lifetime in readable units without changing its duration (for example, 300 seconds is 5 minutes). If the user’s time zone is known, convert expires_at to that time zone and label it explicitly; otherwise show the UTC deadline. Never guess the user’s time zone from their language or the server time zone. Do not omit any connection instructions. Then call list_client with the returned client_token and wait_ms=300000 to check whether a device connects, with a 300-second timeout. Report whether a device connected or the wait timed out. multi_device controls simultaneous connections and invitation reuse.
mcp.create.a.client.connection.token.and.zh-CN: 当用户要求生成或创建 Agenterm 远程连接令牌、连接邀请或远程协助连接时使用本工具，例如“生成远程连接令牌”“创建远程连接邀请”。本工具在 Agenterm 服务端创建私密的客户端连接令牌和邀请，本地生成的随机字符串不能替代。timeout_seconds 设置邀请有效期，单位秒，默认 300 秒（5 分钟）。文本内容和 structuredContent.display_text 均返回固定的英文模板，命令自带 Markdown 代码块，structuredContent 同时保留凭据和平台命令。必须先根据与用户交流所使用的语言完整展示 display_text，保留所有段落及其顺序，命令、URL 和连接令牌必须保持原样。必须将每条命令分别放入 Markdown 代码块，方便准确复制。有效期可换算成易读的单位，但不能改变实际时长（例如 300 秒为 5 分钟）。已知用户时区时，将 expires_at 换算到该时区并明确标注；未知时显示 UTC 截止时间。不得根据用户语言或服务器时区猜测用户时区，也不得省略连接说明。然后使用返回的 client_token 调用 list_client，设置 wait_ms=300000，以 300 秒为超时时间检查设备是否连接成功，并向用户报告连接成功或等待超时。multi_device 控制是否允许多台设备同时连接和重复兑换邀请。

mcp.invitation.timeout.seconds.en: Invitation lifetime in seconds, as a positive integer. Default 300 (5 minutes). Expiry prevents invitation redemption; it does not disconnect devices that have already connected.
mcp.invitation.timeout.seconds.zh-CN: 邀请有效期，单位秒，必须为正整数。默认 300（5 分钟）。过期后不能兑换邀请，已连接的设备不会因此断开。

mcp.target.client.connection.token.requi.en: Target client connection token, required with management access (including stdio and no-password mode). Device-scoped bearer access implicitly selects its own token.
mcp.target.client.connection.token.requi.zh-CN: 目标客户端连接 token；管理访问（包括 stdio 和免密模式）时必须填写。设备范围的 Bearer 访问会自动选择其自身 token。

client.already.connected.to.server.en: This account already has a connection to this server on this computer. Disconnect the existing client before reconnecting.

mcp.list.clients.en: List online devices belonging to the token, with their identifiers and metadata. After create_client generates connection instructions, you MUST call this tool with the returned client_token and wait_ms=300000 to check whether a device connects, with a 300-second timeout. A positive wait_ms waits while no device is online; any online device completes the wait immediately. An empty array means no device was online when the call returned; after the 300-second wait, report that the connection check timed out. Invalid, expired or revoked tokens cannot be used for further waits.
mcp.list.clients.zh-CN: 列出 token 下在线设备的标识和元数据。create_client 生成连接说明后，必须使用返回的 client_token 调用本工具，设置 wait_ms=300000，以 300 秒为超时时间检查设备是否连接成功。wait_ms 为正时，在没有设备在线的情况下等待；任一设备在线都会立即结束等待。空数组表示调用返回时没有在线设备；等待 300 秒后仍无设备在线时，应向用户报告连接检查超时。无效、过期或已撤销的 token 不能继续用于等待。

mcp.wait.for.connection.en: Maximum connection wait in milliseconds while no device is online, 0–300000. After generating connection instructions, you MUST set this to 300000 (300-second timeout). 0 returns a snapshot immediately.
mcp.wait.for.connection.zh-CN: 没有设备在线时等待连接的最长毫秒数，范围 0–300000。生成连接说明后必须设为 300000（超时 300 秒）。0 表示立即返回快照。

mcp.connection.context.en: Tokens, invitations and connection commands are private credentials. Observe devices through list_client; no background agent notifications are sent. Restarting the server frontend preserves runtime connections and state. Restarting the runtime invalidates tokens, invitations and sessions.
mcp.connection.context.zh-CN: Token、邀请和连接命令是私密凭据。通过 list_client 查看设备，无后台 agent 通知。服务端前端重启保留 runtime 中的连接和状态；runtime 重启会使 token、邀请和会话失效。

mcp.client.id.en: Six lowercase letters or digits from list_client, used to select or filter devices. For multi-device tokens it is required when a specific device must be selected and no existing session_id identifies it. Session-list filtering is optional.
mcp.client.id.zh-CN: list_client 返回的 6 位小写字母或数字 ID，用于选择或筛选设备。多设备模式下，操作需要定位设备且无法由已有 session_id 定位时必须提供；会话列表筛选为可选。

unknown.client.id.en: Unknown or offline client_id for this token.
unknown.client.id.zh-CN: 此 Token 下没有该 client_id，或设备已离线。

client.id.required.en: client_id is required for multi-device tokens. Call list_client to select a device.
client.id.required.zh-CN: 多设备 Token 必须提供 client_id，请调用 list_client 选择设备。

multi.device.display.notice.en: Multi-device mode: connection commands can be reused on multiple computers until the invitation expires. Multiple devices may stay connected simultaneously.

connection.retry.en: Connection lost or failed (online %s): %s. Retry #%d in %s.

mcp.execution.env.en: Initial environment overrides for setup, merged with client environment. Change a reused shell through shell commands.

mcp.execution.workflow.en: Execute commands in client-managed terminals. Top-level session_id only reuses an existing terminal and rejects unknown/closed IDs. setup always creates a terminal and contains optional cwd, env and session_id; its ID must be unused. setup with an ID creates a persistent terminal; omit its ID to generate a random anonymous terminal. setup and top-level session_id are mutually exclusive. cwd/env are not top-level arguments. Omit both to create an anonymous terminal. Anonymous terminals close on fast completion or retain the same shell after wait_ms expires. wait_ms defaults to 10000 ms, range 0–20000; 0 retains anonymous terminals immediately. Waiting never kills execution. Returns session_id, command_id, status, output, next_cursor and has_more. status is running (busy), idle (command ended and reusable) or closed (session no longer usable; disconnection does not confirm remote termination). exit_code is present after command completion; error only on failure; truncated only when true. Busy reuse returns session_busy without queueing. The client alone manages terminals and a ten-live-terminal limit; creation fails at capacity, existing-ID reuse remains allowed. Persistent terminals require session_control(action=stop), with no idle expiry. Read output with session_read using next_cursor and drain has_more. exit_code describes the latest command; closed with a disconnection error does not prove the command ended. The server authorizes, routes and caches facts. Commands run with target user permissions; do not override reserved prompt hooks/PS1 or terminal echo settings.
mcp.execution.workflow.zh-CN: 在客户端管理的终端中执行命令。顶级 session_id 仅复用已有终端，未知或已关闭 ID 报错。setup 始终创建终端，包含可选 cwd、env 和 session_id；其中的 ID 必须尚未存在。setup 指定 ID 时创建持久终端，省略 ID 时生成随机 ID 并按匿名终端规则执行。setup 和顶级 session_id 互斥。cwd/env 不再是顶级参数。两者均省略也创建匿名终端。匿名终端快速完成自动关闭，wait_ms 到期则保留同一 shell。wait_ms 默认 10000 毫秒，范围 0–20000；0 立即保留匿名终端，等待不会终止命令。返回 session_id、command_id、status、output、next_cursor、has_more。status 为 running（忙碌）、idle（命令结束且可复用）、closed（会话不可用，断线时远端终止未确认）；命令完成后返回 exit_code，有错误时返回 error，输出丢失时才返回 truncated=true。复用忙碌终端返回 session_busy，不排队。终端管理及每个进程十个存活终端上限仅由客户端裁决；满额新建报错，已有 ID 仍可复用。持久终端需 session_control(action=stop) 主动关闭，不按空闲时间回收。通过 session_read 按 next_cursor 读完 has_more；exit_code 描述最新命令，断线导致 closed 时不能据此确认命令已结束。服务端仅鉴权、路由和缓存事实。命令以目标用户权限执行，不要覆盖保留的提示符钩子、PS1 或终端回显设置。

client.token.expired.en: Client token has expired; the invitation is no longer usable.
client.token.expired.zh-CN: 客户端 Token 已过期，邀请已不可用。

mcp.stop.wait.en: Only for action=stop: maximum wait for a terminal result in milliseconds, 0–20000; default 1000. 0 returns a snapshot immediately. Omit for all other actions.
mcp.stop.wait.zh-CN: 仅 action=stop 可用：请求取消后等待终态的最长毫秒数，范围 0–20000，默认 1000；0 表示立即返回状态快照。其他 action 不得填写。

mcp.stop.accepted.en: True if a cancellation request was sent or is pending. False for a session already ended before this call. This alone never confirms termination.
mcp.stop.accepted.zh-CN: 表示停止请求已发出或正在等待处理；调用前已结束时为 false。此字段本身不能确认进程已停止。

mcp.stop.done.en: True when a terminal result is available or the device connection closed; status and canceled identify the outcome.
mcp.stop.done.zh-CN: 收到终态结果或设备连接关闭时为 true；status 和 canceled 表示结束原因。

mcp.stop.status.en: running: stop is still pending; closed: session is no longer usable. Inspect error: disconnection does not confirm remote process termination.
mcp.stop.status.zh-CN: running：停止尚待确认；closed：会话已不可用。请检查 error，断线不代表远端进程已确认终止。

mcp.result.clients.en: Online devices owned by this token; an empty array means none are currently online.
mcp.result.clients.zh-CN: 此 token 的在线设备；空数组表示当前无在线设备。

mcp.result.client_id.en: Six-character device identifier. Required to select a device for multi-device tokens.
mcp.result.client_id.zh-CN: 六位设备标识；多设备 token 通过此字段选择目标设备。

mcp.result.client_info.en: Device-reported environment metadata. Empty fields mean unknown or not reported.
mcp.result.client_info.zh-CN: 设备上报的环境元数据，空字段表示未知或未上报。

mcp.result.client_version.en: Client application version reported during the connection handshake.
mcp.result.client_version.zh-CN: 客户端在连接握手中上报的应用版本。

mcp.result.arch.en: Client process architecture, such as amd64 or arm64.
mcp.result.arch.zh-CN: 客户端进程架构，例如 amd64 或 arm64。

mcp.result.default_cwd.en: Client working directory at connection time; inherited by a newly created session when cwd is omitted.
mcp.result.default_cwd.zh-CN: 连接时客户端的工作目录；新建会话未指定 cwd 时继承此目录。

mcp.result.hostname.en: Device-reported hostname for display only, not authentication.
mcp.result.hostname.zh-CN: 设备上报的主机名，仅用于展示，不用于认证。

mcp.result.shell.en: Device-reported persistent command interpreter path. Windows sessions use PowerShell; Linux/macOS use the reported shell. Empty means unknown.
mcp.result.shell.zh-CN: 设备上报的持续命令解释器路径；Windows 会话使用 PowerShell，Linux/macOS 使用上报的 shell。空值表示未知。

mcp.result.connected_at.en: UTC connection time in RFC 3339 format.
mcp.result.connected_at.zh-CN: RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 连接时间。

mcp.result.status.en: Connection wait status: waiting or connected.
mcp.result.status.zh-CN: 连接等待状态：waiting 或 connected。

mcp.client.status.en: Device connection display status: Connected, with the latest server-client heartbeat RTT when measured, e.g. Connected · 203ms.
mcp.client.status.zh-CN: 设备连接状态显示文本：Connected；有测量值时附带最近一次服务端与客户端之间的心跳往返延迟，例如 Connected · 203ms。

mcp.result.session_id.en: Session identifier used by session_read and session_control.
mcp.result.session_id.zh-CN: 供 session_read 和 session_control 使用的会话标识。

mcp.result.output.en: Combined terminal output from the requested cursor; may contain echoed input.
mcp.result.output.zh-CN: 从指定游标开始的终端合并输出，可能包含回显输入。

mcp.result.next_cursor.en: Byte offset immediately after the returned output. Pass it as cursor for the next session_read, including when done=true and has_more=true.
mcp.result.next_cursor.zh-CN: 本次返回输出之后的字节偏移；下次 session_read 请用它作为 cursor，包括 done=true 且 has_more=true 时。

mcp.result.truncated.en: Present only as true when the requested cursor predates the oldest retained output. The latest 1 MiB is retained; pagination alone does not truncate.
mcp.result.truncated.zh-CN: 仅请求游标早于最早保留输出时返回 true；保留最近 1 MiB，单纯分页不会截断。

mcp.result.done.en: True when the terminal has ended; a completed command can have done=false and command_done=true.
mcp.result.done.zh-CN: 终端已结束时为 true；单条命令完成时可以 done=false 且 command_done=true。

mcp.result.exit_code.en: Exit code of the latest completed command, or terminal termination if it ended; 0 is success, -1 denotes execution/connection failure. Absent while a command is running.
mcp.result.exit_code.zh-CN: 最新完成命令的退出码，或终端结束时的退出码；0 表示成功，-1 表示执行或连接失败。命令执行中不提供此字段。

mcp.result.canceled.en: True only when the target reported cancellation; a disconnect alone does not confirm cancellation.
mcp.result.canceled.zh-CN: 仅在目标报告取消时为 true，单纯断线不代表已确认取消。

mcp.result.timed_out.en: True if the target reported that the process execution timeout elapsed.
mcp.result.timed_out.zh-CN: 目标报告进程执行超时时为 true。

mcp.result.error.en: Optional execution or connection error. A disconnect does not prove the remote process completed successfully.
mcp.result.error.zh-CN: 可选的执行或连接错误；断线不能证明远程进程成功完成。

mcp.result.accepted.en: Whether the action was sent to the device connection; this does not confirm it was consumed or completed.
mcp.result.accepted.zh-CN: 操作是否已发往设备连接，不代表已被处理或已经完成。

mcp.result.already_done.en: True if the session was already ended when this stop call began; no new cancellation request is sent.
mcp.result.already_done.zh-CN: 本次停止调用开始时会话已结束则为 true，此时不会发送新的取消请求。

mcp.result.token_identifier.en: Public identifier for recognizing the connection token; not an authentication secret.
mcp.result.token_identifier.zh-CN: 用于识别连接令牌的公开标识符，不是认证密钥。

mcp.result.client_token.en: Private credential for this target group. Pass as client_token with management access (including stdio and no-password mode) or as the MCP bearer token for device-scoped access.
mcp.result.client_token.zh-CN: 此目标组的私密凭据；管理访问（包括 stdio 和免密模式）时传入 client_token，设备范围访问时作为 MCP Bearer token。

mcp.result.multi_device.en: True permits multiple simultaneous devices and reuses the invitation until expiry. False allows one device and a single-use invitation.
mcp.result.multi_device.zh-CN: true 允许多台设备同时连接，邀请在过期前可复用；false 仅允许一台设备和单次使用邀请。

mcp.result.invitation.en: Private invitation credential for target-client authorization; expires at expires_at.
mcp.result.invitation.zh-CN: 用于目标客户端授权的私密邀请凭据，在 expires_at 过期。

mcp.result.expires_at.en: Invitation expiry deadline as a UTC RFC 3339 timestamp.
mcp.result.expires_at.zh-CN: 邀请过期截止时间，使用 UTC RFC 3339 时间戳。

mcp.result.macos_linux_command.en: macOS/Linux connection command containing private invitation access.
mcp.result.macos_linux_command.zh-CN: 包含私密邀请访问权限的 macOS/Linux 连接命令。

mcp.result.windows_powershell_command.en: Windows connection command containing private invitation access.
mcp.result.windows_powershell_command.zh-CN: 包含私密邀请访问权限的 Windows 连接命令。

mcp.result.display_text.en: Fixed English connection template with Markdown code blocks, identical to the tool's text content. Present all sections in order in the user's language; keep commands, URLs and tokens unchanged. Each command must be placed in its own Markdown code block. Express the lifetime in readable equivalent units. If the user's time zone is known, convert expires_at and label the time zone; otherwise show UTC. Do not infer the time zone from language or server settings.
mcp.result.display_text.zh-CN: 固定的英文连接模板，命令自带 Markdown 代码块，与工具的文本内容一致。按顺序以用户使用的语言展示所有段落；命令、URL 和令牌保持原样，每条命令必须分别放入 Markdown 代码块。有效期可换算为等价的易读单位；已知用户时区时可换算 expires_at 并标注时区，否则显示 UTC。不得根据语言或服务器设置推测用户时区。

mcp.session.list.en: List this token’s retained sessions in creation order, optionally filtered by client_id. Each entry has session_id, client_id, command, command_id and status (running/idle/closed), with exit_code/error when available. Closed history remains discoverable for result recovery, up to 30 minutes or replacement. This does not create, close or consume terminals.
mcp.session.list.zh-CN: 按创建时间列出此 token 的保留会话，可按 client_id 筛选。每条包含 session_id、client_id、command、command_id、status（running/idle/closed），按需带 exit_code/error。已关闭记录仍可找回结果，最多保留 30 分钟或被替换。查询不会创建、关闭或占用终端。

mcp.session.max.bytes.en: Maximum output bytes per read, 4–65536; default 16384. May return fewer bytes to preserve UTF-8 boundaries. Continue with next_cursor while has_more=true.
mcp.session.max.bytes.zh-CN: 单次读取最多返回的输出字节数，范围 4–65536，默认 16384。为保持 UTF-8 字符完整，可能返回更少字节。has_more=true 时用 next_cursor 继续读取。

mcp.result.session_controls.en: Supported acknowledged session operations: interrupt and/or eof. An empty list means these operations are unavailable; update older clients if needed.
mcp.result.session_controls.zh-CN: 客户端支持并能确认的会话操作：interrupt 和/或 eof。空列表表示不可用，旧客户端可能需要更新。

mcp.result.sessions.en: Retained sessions owned by this client token, optionally filtered by device.
mcp.result.sessions.zh-CN: 该客户端 token 拥有的保留会话，可按设备筛选。

mcp.result.started_at.zh-CN: 会话创建时间，UTC，RFC 3339 格式。

mcp.result.ended_at.en: Session completion time in UTC (RFC 3339); present only after the session ends.
mcp.result.ended_at.zh-CN: 会话结束时间，UTC，RFC 3339 格式；仅在会话结束后返回。

mcp.result.command.en: Latest command submitted through execute_command for this session; does not track subsequent stdin input.
mcp.result.command.zh-CN: 此会话最新通过 execute_command 提交的命令，不跟踪后续通过标准输入发送的内容。

mcp.session.status.en: idle: terminal ready; running: command active; stopping: terminal closing; finished: terminal ended.
mcp.session.status.zh-CN: idle：终端空闲；running：命令执行中；stopping：终端正在关闭；finished：终端已结束。

mcp.result.output_start_cursor.en: Earliest retained output byte offset; pass as cursor to read available history.
mcp.result.output_start_cursor.zh-CN: 最早保留输出的字节偏移，可作为 cursor 读取现有历史。

mcp.result.output_end_cursor.en: Byte offset after the latest retained output; using it as cursor skips existing output and waits for new output.
mcp.result.output_end_cursor.zh-CN: 当前保留输出末尾之后的字节偏移；用作 cursor 会跳过现有输出，只读取后续新增内容。

mcp.result.has_more.en: Whether more retained output remains after next_cursor. May be true even when done=true; continue reading to drain output.
mcp.result.has_more.zh-CN: next_cursor 之后是否仍有保留输出；即使 done=true 也可能为 true，此时应继续读取。

mcp.result.delivered.en: True only after the client confirms it performed the requested signal or EOF operation. Does not guarantee the program consumed it, stopped or exited.
mcp.result.delivered.zh-CN: 仅在客户端确认已执行所请求的信号或 EOF 操作后为 true；不保证程序已处理、停止或退出。

session.read.invalid.limit.en: max_bytes must be an integer between 4 and 65536.
session.read.invalid.limit.zh-CN: max_bytes 必须为 4 到 65536 之间的整数。

session.read.invalid.arguments.en: cursor must be nonnegative and wait_ms must be between 0 and 20000.
session.read.invalid.arguments.zh-CN: cursor 不得为负数，wait_ms 必须在 0 到 20000 之间。

session.cursor.invalid.boundary.en: cursor must point to a UTF-8 character boundary; use the returned next_cursor.
session.cursor.invalid.boundary.zh-CN: cursor 必须位于 UTF-8 字符边界，请使用返回的 next_cursor。

session.control.unsupported.en: This client does not support the requested session operation. Check session_controls and update the client if needed.
session.control.unsupported.zh-CN: 该客户端不支持此会话操作，请检查 session_controls，必要时更新客户端。

session.control.invalid.response.en: Invalid session control acknowledgment from client.
session.control.invalid.response.zh-CN: 客户端返回了无效的会话控制确认。

session.control.unconfirmed.en: Session operation delivery is unconfirmed; it may have been applied. Read session output before retrying: %v
session.control.unconfirmed.zh-CN: 尚未确认会话操作的投递状态，操作可能已经执行。重试前请先读取会话输出：%v

session.control.no.foreground.en: The terminal has no foreground process group to interrupt.
session.control.no.foreground.zh-CN: 终端没有可中断的前台进程组。

session.eof.requires.canonical.en: EOF requires canonical terminal mode with VEOF enabled; raw mode is unsupported.
session.eof.requires.canonical.zh-CN: EOF 需要启用 VEOF 的规范终端模式，不支持原始模式。

session.input.queue.full.en: Session input queue is full; input was not queued.
session.input.queue.full.zh-CN: 会话输入队列已满，此次输入未入队。

mcp.session.control.en: Control an existing session using input, interrupt, eof or stop. Only input accepts input text, without adding a newline; idle sessions reject it. input/interrupt/eof return ok=true after client acknowledgment, not proof the program consumed or handled it. Check client_info.session_controls before interrupt/eof; behavior is platform-dependent. stop closes the terminal and alone accepts wait_ms (default 1000, 0–20000). Its result is status=running while pending or closed when the session is unusable, with exit_code/error when available. A disconnection error leaves remote termination unconfirmed. Repeated stop is safe and does not resend a pending request. Never blindly retry input or signals after uncertain delivery. Read output and final state with session_read.
mcp.session.control.zh-CN: 通过 input、interrupt、eof 或 stop 控制已有会话。仅 input 接受 input 文本，不自动加换行；空闲会话拒绝输入。input/interrupt/eof 在客户端确认后返回 ok=true，不保证程序已消费或处理。中断和 EOF 前查看 client_info.session_controls，具体行为因平台而异。stop 关闭终端，仅此操作接受 wait_ms（默认 1000，范围 0–20000）；返回 status=running 表示待确认，closed 表示会话不可用，按需带 exit_code/error。断线错误表示远端终止未确认。重复 stop 不重发待确认请求；投递不确定时勿盲目重试输入或信号。通过 session_read 读取输出及后续状态。

mcp.session.control.action.en: Operation on this session: input sends stdin text (requires input); interrupt signals the foreground task; eof ends input according to platform semantics; stop cancels the entire session (optional wait_ms).
mcp.session.control.action.zh-CN: 会话操作：input 发送标准输入（必须带 input）；interrupt 中断前台任务；eof 按平台语义发送输入结束；stop 取消整个会话（可选 wait_ms）。

mcp.result.action.en: The session_control action this result describes; determines which acknowledgment or terminal fields apply.
mcp.result.action.zh-CN: 本结果对应的 session_control 操作，决定应读取哪些发送确认或终态字段。

session.control.invalid.arguments.en: Use action=input with input, interrupt/eof without input or wait_ms, or stop with optional wait_ms (0–20000). A nonempty session_id is required.
session.control.invalid.arguments.zh-CN: action=input 必须带 input；interrupt/eof 不得带 input 或 wait_ms；stop 仅可附带 wait_ms（0–20000）。session_id 必须非空。

runtime.compatibility.error.en:
Incompatible runtime: server %s (API %s), runtime %s (API %s), runtime PID %s.
The running runtime will not be stopped or restarted automatically.
Use a server compatible with runtime API %s to stop this instance, for example:
  %s
Or stop runtime manually in the same user and host/container environment:
  %s
Stopping runtime disconnects clients and clears in-memory credentials and sessions.
runtime.compatibility.error.zh-CN:
Runtime 不兼容：server %s（API %s），runtime %s（API %s），runtime PID %s。
不会自动停止或重启运行中的 runtime。
请使用兼容 runtime API %s 的 server 停止当前实例，例如：
  %s
或在相同用户及主机/容器环境中手动停止 runtime：
  %s
停止 runtime 会断开客户端连接，并清空内存中的凭证和会话。

runtime.compatibility.manual.unknown.en: Confirm the runtime PID first, then run: kill -TERM <PID>
runtime.compatibility.manual.unknown.zh-CN: 先确认 runtime PID，再执行：kill -TERM <PID>

mcp.p2p.transfer.start.en: Recommended only when large files need to be transferred between the local machine (the Agent execution environment) and a connected remote computer. Start the remote p2p-cli bootstrap and wait only until it registers for negotiation. Returns private shell and PowerShell bootstrap scripts: execute the one matching the Agent execution environment to download and start the local component. Bootstrap output includes executable: use that absolute path for status, cp and stop locally. File bytes use a direct encrypted peer connection, never this MCP service. Repeated calls reuse the active connection for this client; stop the existing P2P connection before starting a new one.
mcp.p2p.transfer.start.zh-CN: 仅建议在本机与已连接的远程电脑之间需要传输大文件时使用。启动远端 p2p-cli 初始化脚本，仅等待远端注册协商后返回。返回的 shell 和 PowerShell 脚本含私有接入凭据；请按 Agent 实际执行环境选择并执行，以下载并启动本机组件。脚本输出包含 executable，请用该绝对路径在本机执行 status、cp 和 stop。文件通过加密直连传输，不经过 MCP 服务。重复调用复用该客户端的活动连接，重新创建前请停止现有 P2P 连接。

mcp.result.local_client_id.en: Local p2p-cli identifier used in CLIENT:PATH copy operands.
mcp.result.local_client_id.zh-CN: 用于 CLIENT:PATH 复制路径的本机 p2p-cli 标识。

mcp.result.remote_client_id.en: Remote p2p-cli identifier used in CLIENT:PATH copy operands.
mcp.result.remote_client_id.zh-CN: 用于 CLIENT:PATH 复制路径的远端 p2p-cli 标识。

mcp.result.state.en: Current P2P initialization state; waiting_for_agent means the remote registered, not that P2P connected.
mcp.result.state.zh-CN: P2P 初始化状态；waiting_for_agent 表示远端已注册，不表示直连已经成功。

mcp.result.shell_script.en: Private POSIX shell bootstrap for the Agent environment on macOS or Linux.
mcp.result.shell_script.zh-CN: 供 macOS 或 Linux Agent 执行环境使用的私有 shell 初始化脚本。

mcp.result.powershell_script.en: Private PowerShell bootstrap for the Agent environment on Windows.
mcp.result.powershell_script.zh-CN: 供 Windows Agent 执行环境使用的私有 PowerShell 初始化脚本。

mcp.result.p2p.en: Whether the client supports built-in p2p-cli initialization.
mcp.result.p2p.zh-CN: 客户端是否支持内置 p2p-cli 初始化。

session.client.upgrade.required.en: This client does not support persistent sessions. Update the client before executing commands.
session.client.upgrade.required.zh-CN: 此客户端不支持持续会话，请更新客户端后执行命令。

session.busy.en: session_busy: session %s is running a command. Read or control it, or omit the terminal target for independent work.
session.busy.zh-CN: session_busy：会话 %s 正在执行命令，请读取或控制该会话，或不指定终端以独立执行。

session.initial.options.only.en: cwd and env initialize a new terminal only. Change a reused shell with cd/export, or create another terminal.
session.initial.options.only.zh-CN: cwd 和 env 仅用于初始化新终端；复用时通过 shell 命令修改目录和环境，或新建其他终端。

session.command.changed.en: A newer command has started in this session. Use session_read without command_id to read the retained session output.
session.command.changed.zh-CN: 此会话已开始更新的命令；可不带 command_id 调用 session_read 读取保留输出。

mcp.execution.command.id.en: Optional command identity returned by execute_command; rejects a snapshot if the session has advanced to another command.
mcp.execution.command.id.zh-CN: execute_command 返回的可选命令标识；若会话已切换到下一条命令则拒绝返回混淆的快照。

mcp.execution.wait.en: Completion wait in milliseconds, 0–20000; default 10000. Anonymous terminals close if the command finishes first; otherwise the client retains the same shell under a random session_id. 0 retains immediately. Never stops a running command.
mcp.execution.wait.zh-CN: 等待命令完成的时间，0–20000 毫秒，默认 10000。匿名终端内命令先完成则自动关闭，否则客户端将同一 shell 保留并返回随机 session_id；0 表示立即保留。不会终止运行中的命令。

mcp.result.session_alive.en: Whether this terminal can accept another command when idle.
mcp.result.session_alive.zh-CN: 此终端在空闲时是否可继续执行命令。

mcp.result.command_done.en: Whether the latest command has completed, independently of terminal lifetime.
mcp.result.command_done.zh-CN: 最新命令是否已结束，与终端生命周期独立。

mcp.result.command_id.en: Identity of the latest submitted command.

mcp.result.persistent_sessions.en: Whether this client supports persistent command sessions.
mcp.result.persistent_sessions.zh-CN: 此客户端是否支持持续命令会话。

mcp.execution.status.en: running: terminal busy or stop pending; idle: command ended and reusable; closed: session is no longer usable. A disconnection error means remote process termination is unconfirmed.
mcp.execution.status.zh-CN: running：终端忙碌或停止待确认；idle：命令结束且可复用；closed：会话已不可用。若有断线错误，远端进程是否终止尚未确认。

mcp.execution.session.id.en: Reuse an existing session only. Unknown or closed IDs are rejected. To create a terminal, use setup instead.
mcp.execution.session.id.zh-CN: 仅复用已有会话；未知或已关闭 ID 报错。需要创建终端时使用 setup。

session.input.requires.command.en: No command is waiting for input. Submit new commands with execute_command.
session.input.requires.command.zh-CN: 当前没有命令可接收输入，请使用 execute_command 执行新命令。

mcp.result.persistent.en: Whether the terminal is retained after command completion and requires explicit stop (unless its shell exits or disconnects).
mcp.result.persistent.zh-CN: 终端是否在命令完成后继续保留，需要主动 stop 关闭（shell 自行退出或断线除外）。

mcp.result.promoted.en: Whether this terminal began anonymously and was retained when its initial wait elapsed (including wait_ms=0).
mcp.result.promoted.zh-CN: 终端是否从匿名终端在首次等待到期后保留而来，包括 wait_ms=0。

session.setup.conflict.en: setup cannot be combined with top-level session_id.
session.setup.conflict.zh-CN: setup 不能与顶级 session_id 同时使用。

session.options.require.setup.en: cwd and env must be provided inside setup.
session.options.require.setup.zh-CN: cwd 和 env 必须放在 setup 中。

session.already.exists.en: Session %s already exists. Use top-level session_id to reuse it.
session.already.exists.zh-CN: 会话 %s 已存在，请通过顶级 session_id 复用。

mcp.execution.setup.en: Create a new terminal using optional cwd, env and session_id. Cannot be combined with top-level session_id. An existing setup.session_id is rejected. Omit its ID for a generated anonymous terminal with the usual wait-based lifetime.
mcp.execution.setup.zh-CN: 新建终端，可包含 cwd、env 和 session_id。不能与顶级 session_id 同时使用；setup.session_id 已存在时会报错。省略其中的 ID 时生成随机 ID，仍按匿名终端等待规则执行。

mcp.execution.setup.session.id.en: Optional ID for a new persistent terminal; fails if already present. Omit to generate a random ID and follow anonymous terminal lifetime.
mcp.execution.setup.session.id.zh-CN: 新建持久终端的可选 ID；已存在则报错。省略时生成随机 ID，并按匿名终端生命周期执行。

mcp.result.ok.en: The client acknowledged the operation request; does not prove the program consumed input or handled a signal.
mcp.result.ok.zh-CN: 客户端已确认操作请求，不代表程序已消费输入或处理中断。

session.disconnected.unconfirmed.en: client disconnected; remote process termination is unconfirmed
session.disconnected.unconfirmed.zh-CN: 客户端已断开；远端进程是否终止尚未确认

mcp.close.client.en: Close selected online devices for this token. Pass client_ids from list_client to close only those devices. Omit client_ids to close all online devices and revoke the token and its invitations, including when no devices are online. Every ID must belong to this token. Closing a device stops its sessions and active transfers.
mcp.close.client.zh-CN: 关闭此 token 下选定的在线设备。传入 list_client 返回的 client_ids 时只关闭指定设备；不传则关闭所有在线设备并撤销 token 和其邀请，即使当前没有在线设备也会撤销。所有 ID 必须属于此 token。关闭设备会停止其会话和进行中的传输。

mcp.client.ids.en: Unique device IDs from list_client. Omit to close all online devices and revoke the token and its invitations; an empty array is not allowed.
mcp.client.ids.zh-CN: list_client 返回的设备 ID，不能重复。不传则关闭全部在线设备并撤销 token 和邀请；不允许空数组。

mcp.result.client_ids.en: IDs of devices closed by this call.
